content: However, some recent studies BIBREF11 reveal that the disentanglement of content and style representations may not be achieved in practice. Therefore, some other research studies BIBREF9 , BIBREF10 strive to separate content and style by removing stylistic words. Nonetheless, many non-ironic sentences do not have specific stylistic words and as a result, we find it difficult to transfer non-ironic sentences to ironic sentences through this way in practice.
